_doc: Machine-readable registry of Cracker forward-registered hypotheses and sensitivity items. Append-only in spirit — entries may gain a 'resolution' but never be edited or removed. The git history of this file + docs/cracker-ledger.md is the tamper-evident record. Phase-5/8 runners consume this file; do not rely on session memory.

hypotheses.claim: Replication of F5b on the L3 forward lockbox: IC_twin(dStar/ct_vol, 5m) - IC_real(dStar/ct_vol, 5m) > 0
Sweep-exhaustion, level-agnostic (real+placebo pooled): IC(sweep, y(5m)) < 0 on swept-and-reclaimed visits (deep-fast spike-reclaims predict LESS follow-through)

The recurring sub-MDE 'NQ 5m structure bounce': hvn-vs-placebo dy(5m) > 0 (F1 shape: +4.3/+4.6pt train/valid) AND stacked-vs-lone confluence dy(5m) > 0 (F2 shape: +6.1/+7.1pt). Two-part claim, both parts must hold sign.

Replenishment intensity (fill->repost <=1.5s count at the defending zone during the visit) predicts 1m continuation INTO the level: IC(refills, y(1m)) < 0 on ES real-source visits (emergent from F11's undeclared-horizon cell: train -0.062 sig / valid -0.060 sig, twin n.s.)
Cont-Stoikov queue-imbalance predicts next-second mid move (one-sided positive)
Sweep intensity predicts 1s continuation in sweep direction (dose-response)

resolution.verdict: EDGE - first in program. Train +0.112/valid +0.074 both sig, p=0.0005 BH-significant; top-decile +0.836pt NQ (1.62 half-spreads) / +0.690pt ES (5.18 half-spreads), 13/14 days positive both. Tail-tradability -> E3 Gate-2.

hypotheses.claim: Top-decile sweep-continuation is NET-POSITIVE for a TAKER after all-in costs at realistic latency. Trade sim: enter taker in sweep dir at event_ts+L, exit taker at event_ts+H. Net(L,H) = dir*(ms_H - ms_L) - 2*halfspread_event - fees_rt. Cells: L in {0 (upper bound, dominates all L<250ms incl. the 100ms assumption), 250ms (exact, banked), 500ms (dominated by 250ms cell — impact curve flat/declining after 250ms)}; H in {1s, 5s, 10s, 30s}. Threshold: top-decile intensity from TRAIN days (chrono 60/40), applied unchanged to VALID; verdict on VALID. Costs: spread rt = 2*(spread_ticks*0.25/2) per event (event-time spread; optimistic post-sweep -> strengthens a NO); fees all-in Tradovate micros $0.74/side: MNQ $1.48rt = 0.74 NQpt, MES $1.48rt = 0.296 ESpt. PRIMARY CELL: NQ, L=0, H=1s. DECISION RULE: if L=0 net<=0 at every H -> NO-TRADE(taker) for all latency cells by dominance; else adjudicate the exact L=250ms cells. SECONDARY (declared): QI-agreement overlay (sign(qi)==dir at event), top-5% and top-2% train-threshold cuts, per-cell day-block bootstrap CI95 + positive-day counts. Latency grid grounding: measured live infra 2026-07-08 (trader log) = detection-to-order ~150ms + REST order ~50-100ms -> 250ms is the honest base case; 100ms requires WS orders + warm auth; sub-100ms is not our stack.

resolution.verdict: NO-TRADE (taker), all cells, both symbols. Decision rule triggered: L=0 upper-bound net <= 0 at every H. PRIMARY (NQ top-10%, L=0, H=1s, VALID): net -1.574pt CI[-1.762,-1.344], 0/5 days positive; exact L=250ms cells -2.0 to -2.4pt. ES best cell -0.019 CI[-0.400,+0.179] at L=0/H=5s, -0.49 at L=250. QI overlay does not rescue (all neg). Honest caveat: VALID-period gross tail continuation (+0.22pt L=0 H=1s) far below full-sample descriptive (+0.836) -- SWEEP-1S stands as a PREDICTION edge; the taker-tradable magnitude does not exist. Open paths: maker/passive execution (needs queue-position replay, Phase-5 scope), QI as execution overlay for the existing live book, composition.

hypotheses.claim: Footprint diagonal-stack imbalance (>=3 consecutive prices each >=3:1 diagonally imbalanced, canonical definition; intensity = sum log1p(ratio)) predicts direction-signed continuation. Declared horizons {1s, 10s} ms mid-based + {1m, 5m} drift-adjusted; TWO-SIDED (continuation vs exhaustion both live). Primary screen L2-NQ; L3-NQ + ES sign-consistency. Dose-response IC, chrono 60/40, day-block bootstrap. Smoke 06-18: 1,070 events L2-NQ / 895 L3-NQ.

resolution.verdict: NULL at all 4 declared cells, at near-max power (44,966 events / 45d L2-NQ). ICs +0.000/+0.009/+0.006/+0.004 at 1s/10s/1m/5m; best p=0.056 (10s) with IC +0.009 = economically nil; zero BH survivors; consistency sets flat or sign-inconsistent (L3-NQ negative at every cell). Mean y(1s) = 0.06 half-spreads. The canonical footprint stacked-imbalance signal carries no directional information on NQ/ES at 1s-5m.

hypotheses.claim: Wall-cluster (>=3 chained resting walls, each >=5x trailing-median level size, within 3xNEAR_TICKS of mid, gaps <=0.5xNEAR_TICKS; intensity = cluster mass / median; bid cluster = bullish defense) predicts direction-signed continuation. Same declared cells/harness as E0.2-STACKIMB; TWO-SIDED (defense-holds vs magnet/spoof both live). Primary screen L2-NQ with L3-NQ consistency (L3 richer: smoke 06-18 = 33 events L3 vs 4 L2; if L2 is event-starved the L3-NQ cells carry the verdict — declared now, before outcomes).

resolution.verdict: UNDERPOWERED by construction at every declared cell (350 events/40d L2-NQ, 128 L3-NQ; MDE 0.21-0.28 vs rho* 0.05). ES produced ZERO events on both stores - the thick uniform ES book never shows a 5x-median wall at 3pt scan range (a detector-scale fact, recorded for Phase 8). No verdict on the mechanism; forward-accrues via the nightly job; thresholds belong to the Phase-8 sweep. Descriptive only: L3-NQ 1s consistency +0.106 (n=128).

hypotheses.claim: FLIP (clean-impulse) expectancy at fixed brackets is NEGATIVE on high-morning-IV days: trailing-tercile T3 of NDX morning IV (first-30-min mean, knowledge 10:00 ET, boundaries from all prior quantdata_features days) -> skip FLIP. In-sample: T3 41% WR / -6.9pt vs T2 67% / +30.8pt, day-block perm p=0.001 (11 vs 21 days, both directions hit, days interleaved) — BUT FAILED the independent-pool replication (skipped FLIPs flat across terciles: T2 -0.4 vs T3 -1.0pt), so this is a FORWARD hypothesis only, not armable. Resolve at >=30 forward FLIP sims spanning >=5 T3 days.

Relaxing the FLIP/CONT cooldown gate to CAP-2 (take a cooldown-skipped signal only when <2 positions open) is net-positive forward. In-sample (05-05->07-08, n=45 standalone sims): all-taken +528pt (51% WR, but max 6 stacked contracts, 60% of value in n=9 CONT); cap-2 takes 32/45 for +260pt with bounded risk. CAUTION: live shadow (cooldown-shadow.ts -> shadow_trades, running since 06-10) shows the accrued month NEGATIVE: -34.8pt on n=5. Resolver: scripts/cooldown_cap2_resolve.ts (reconstructs cap-2 concurrency from positions.db + shadow intervals). RESOLUTION RULE (frozen): at >=20 forward shadow trades (days > 2026-07-08) or 2026-10-08 hard stop; ADOPT cap-2 only if forward total > 0 AND day-block sign-flip p < 0.10.

sensitivityItems.claim: Visit trigger band (= sigma_1m, avg ~18pt NQ in this regime) may DILUTE effects via drive-by visits. Re-run ladder survivors (F5b) and headline nulls (F6, F8) at band in {0.5*sigma_1m, min(sigma_1m, 8pt NQ / 2pt ES)}.
